subject: Friday Leadership Pulse — OKR spot-check, prioritized risks & QBR asks
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Friday Leadership Pulse — OKR spot-check, prioritized risks & QBR asks

Team —

Attaching a condensed Q2 OKR snapshot and a short QBR prep checklist (attachments). This is a focused read — please scan and action the asks below before EOD Monday so we can lock the dry-run agenda.

Headline wins (last week):
- Serving throughput: +18% sustained for dedicated workloads after the new batching policy (see sheet tab "throughput").
- Onboarding: Two new mid-market pilots signed (Acme & HarborLabs) — expected ARR influence in Q3.
- Observability: Console latency breakdown shipped; initial token-level cost views are live for internal trials.

Top risks (prioritized):
1) Latency regression on long-context chat flows (owner: Jonas) — correlated to KV-cache misses; 7% of requests see >200ms p95 increase. Mitigation: full profile run and temporary conservative KV settings for canary customers.
2) Contracting/procurement delay with HarborLabs (owner: Monica) — legal comments outstanding re: data residency. Ask: escalation to sales ops if not resolved by Tue EOD.
3) QBR deck readiness — missing consolidated performance slides and customer impact notes (owner: Marcus).

Asks (with due dates):
- Jonas: Deliver KV-cache profiling summary + short mitigation plan by Mon 10:00am PT. Attach results to the QBR deck (tab: performance).
- Monica: Confirm procurement ETA for HarborLabs and loop in Sales Ops by Tue noon if still open.
- Maya: Sanity-check the OKR numbers in the attached spreadsheet (esp. "cost per 1k tokens" calc) and confirm any adjustments by Mon 5:00pm PT.
- All: Review the QBR agenda in the Drive link and flag items you must present by Mon 3pm.

Attachments: 2027Q2_OKR_Snapshot.xlsx, QBR_Prepare_Notes_v2.pdf

Thanks — short and tactical here. If anything is blocking your ability to meet the asks, reply inline so I can reprioritize.

Marcus Lin
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:20:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Friday Leadership Pulse — OKR spot-check, prioritized risks & QBR asks

Thanks Marcus. Quick update on risk #1 (latency regression / KV-cache):
- Root cause: we see an interaction between prefetch heuristics and the new attention kernel for long-context models; cache churn for multi-turn sessions spikes under specific prompt patterns.
- Impact: ~7% of requests (primarily chat agents using >8k tokens) show p95 +220ms.
- Interim mitigation (this morning): deployed conservative prefetch settings to canary pool; p95 for canary traffic down ~110ms.

Plan: finish a full-profile run by Mon 9am PT and include a short slide that shows traffic mix + mitigation options (revert kernel or tune heuristics). I'll attach the profile CSV to the deck.

Also flagging a new-ish commercial risk: partner marketplace certification for our dedicated offering is slipping (third-party review delayed). If certification misses the QBR window, sales may push for a carve-out credit. Monica — can you coordinate with Sales Ops to confirm exposure and possible credit thresholds?

On Wed, Apr 21, 2027 at 09:03 AM Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com> wrote:

Jonas
